description: DeerDawn helps users resume project work in ChatGPT by loading structured briefs with current tasks, decisions, open questions, and durable technical context. Users can search and update that context, organize projects and task boards, and record useful paths and findings that carry across their connected AI tools.

defaultPrompt: Catch me up on my current project and what I should do next.
Search my project memory for recent decisions and open questions.
Show me my task board and the work that is currently in progress.
